howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.metaDescription: Radhe Foods sells Indian groceries from stock: you order online, pay securely at checkout and we deliver across Germany. Questions and answers.
howItWorks.intro: We keep Indian groceries in stock in Germany. You order what you need, pay at checkout, and we deliver to your door.
howItWorks.a1: You can browse and fill your cart without one. To order you sign in with your email address and a code we send you; no password needed. Your account is created with your first sign-in.
howItWorks.a2: At checkout, by card or PayPal on the secure page of Stripe. Your order is confirmed the moment the payment goes through. Nothing is charged before, and nothing is paid later.
howItWorks.a3: We pack paid orders and deliver them across Germany with our own driver or as a parcel with DHL or Hermes. You see the delivery time at checkout and on your order; for parcels you get a tracking link.
howItWorks.q4: Can I change or cancel my order?
howItWorks.a4: A placed order cannot be changed. You can cancel it in your account until it is on its way, and order again. What you paid is refunded.
howItWorks.q5: What if something is missing or damaged?
howItWorks.a5: Tell us, or ask for a return in your account within the return window after delivery. Radhe Foods checks every request, corrects the bill with a credit note and refunds the difference.
howItWorks.q6: Why can I not order a product right now?
howItWorks.a6: It is either sold out or not available at the moment. Nothing is reserved before a payment, so a product can sell out while you shop; your order page tells you if that happens, and nothing is charged.

delivery.title: Delivery and payment
delivery.metaDescription: Delivery across Germany, delivery fees, delivery time, payment at checkout by card or PayPal, cancellation and returns at Radhe Foods.
delivery.intro: What delivery costs, when it comes and how you pay.
delivery.areaText: We deliver to every address in Germany. Your order comes with our own driver or as a parcel with DHL or Hermes; we choose the way that suits your address and tell you when it is on its way, with a tracking link for parcels.
delivery.feeIntro: The fee depends on the value of the goods in your order. All prices in the shop include VAT; the delivery fee is added once per order.
delivery.feeUnknown: The delivery fee is shown in your cart before you order.

delivery.timeUnknown: The delivery time is shown at checkout and on your order.
delivery.timeNote: The delivery time is an estimate. If your order is delayed, we tell you by email.
delivery.payText: You pay when you order, on the secure payment page of Stripe:
delivery.payConfirm: Your order is confirmed the moment the payment goes through, and the invoice comes with the confirmation email. Nothing is charged before you confirm, and nothing is paid later.
